requisito: Simulates running a list of (job_id, esiti) jobs allowing at most max_tentativi attempts per job (valid outcomes "OK" or "KO", ignoring whitespace and case; any other outcome raises ValueError). Skips None entries, empty/None job_id, or empty/None esiti; returns "non valido" if max_tentativi <= 0 or lavori is None. Records failed job_id values into scarti (a new list if None) and returns succeeded count, failed count, average attempts per processed job (1 decimal place), and the scarti list.

difetti.indizio: Check the default parameter values in the esegui_coda function signature.
difetti.spiegazione: The mutable default argument scarti=[] is shared across subsequent calls that omit the parameter, leaving failed jobs from earlier calls accumulated in the list.

difetti.indizio: Look at the condition that stops the loop when a job reaches the attempt limit.
difetti.spiegazione: Using usati > max_tentativi instead of >= allows one extra attempt beyond max_tentativi before stopping the loop.

difetti.indizio: Look at the denominator used when calculating average attempts.
difetti.spiegazione: The average divides by len(lavori) (including None or skipped entries) instead of processati, undercounting the average whenever the queue contains ignored items.

difetti.indizio: Check how an unknown outcome is handled in the inner attempts loop.
difetti.spiegazione: The except ValueError block swallows the invalid outcome error by breaking out of the loop instead of letting ValueError propagate as specified.

difetti.indizio: Look at what value is added to the tentativi_tot accumulator after each job.
difetti.spiegazione: Adding 1 instead of usati counts only a single attempt per job regardless of how many retries were executed.

difetti.indizio: Look at the average attempts calculation when processati is greater than zero.
difetti.spiegazione: Using // performs integer division, truncating decimals and returning an integer (for example, 1 instead of 1.0 or 1.5).
